Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

18:12057-1987 



Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 
HONING STONES 



( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and designation of abrasive honing stones which, when held in a 
groove, are intended for use on honing machines. 

2- Types 

a) Square section honing stone, and 

b) Rectangular section honing stone. 
3. Dimensions

Adopted 1 April 1987

4. Designation — Designation of honing stone shall consist of details according to the marking 
systems"on abrasive products given in 13:551-1966 'Marking system for grinding wheels ( revised )\ and 
the nominal size (width x thickness x length). 

4.1 Designation of honing stone of square cross section with abrasive details 51A36L5V23 (see 
13:551-1966) and nominal size 3 x 3 x 40, that is, honing stone of width and thickness a = 3 mm and 
length / = 40 mm shall be designated as: 

Honing Stone 51A36L5V23 - 3 x 3 x 40 13:12057 

4.2 Designation of honing stone of rectangular cross section with abrasive details 51A36L5V23 (see 
13:551-1966) and nominal size 4 x 3 x 40, that is, honing stone of width b = 4 mm, thickness /? = 3 mm 
and length / = 40 mm, shall be designated as. 

Honing Stone 51A36L5V23 - 4 x 3 x 40 13:12057 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard is in alignment with ISO 3920-1976 'Honing stones of square section— Designation 
and dimension' and ISO 3921-1976 'Honing stones of rectangular section — Designation and dimensions', 
issued by International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), except that; 

a) the tolerances on dimensions have been given by the leading manufacturer's of the product; 

b) non-preferred sizes given in above ISO standard have not been adopted; 

c) a few more popular sizes have been included; and 

d) In designation, the abrasive deiaiis according to 13:551-1366 nave also been Included. 



Printed a! Britannia Catendar Mfg Co. Calcutta, India
